coverage: Kalshi quotes captured every ~2 hours; selected NFL windows include timestamped sportsbook no-vig consensus from Vercel when fresh. Best asks are not fills.

settlements.note: Verified public market outcomes linked to archived quotes. First ask is not a fill; no strategy ROI is implied.

paperOneContract.note: Fixed first screen-positive quote per game; theoretical 1-contract cost including fees and 1c slippage. Assumes a fill at ask, ignores market impact; NOT actual or reliably executable profit.

pairedEvidence.limitation: Pregame quotes only if bookmaker timestamps ≤60 minutes old. Kalshi kickoff timing not independently verified by the collector; price comparison is research, not a trade recommendation.
